name: digiid-core
install: Copy packages/digiid-core from the digi-id.io repository
summary: URI helpers, key derivation and signature verification that run in browsers and Node. Powers this site's demo and playground; tested against the published vectors.

name: digiid-js
summary: Build challenges and verify wallet signatures in any Node.js backend.

name: digiid-php
summary: Pure PHP implementation with a working login example. Requires the GMP extension; no node needed.

name: Digi-ID for WordPress
summary: Adds Digi-ID login to the WordPress login screen. Last tested with WordPress 4.1; requires the GMP extension.

name: Digi-ID for phpBB
install: Copy to ext/DigiByte/digiid and enable in the ACP
summary: Passwordless forum login; users link a wallet under UCP → My Digi-ID. Requires the GMP extension.
